workarounds.note: every colour of the tabs, the index, the letter heads and the title band carries its hex beside its paletteId, because design slots never read the palette: a reader who swaps colorPalette must rewrite those hexes too

a paper-coloured box 45 mm deep sits at the back of the title band: under a page-span heading the column rule starts at the top of the text block and would cross the title and the anchor, although the band is a whole number of grid lines deep

the title style sets its hidden heading at body size: a page-span heading is wrapped at the column width, and {titleText} joins the wrapped lines with a space, so at the default H1 size the title broke after 'Word-' and the band printed 'Word- Book'

level 1 states breakBefore: { enabled: false }: any headings object already drops the H1 page break in 1.4.1, and the explicit value keeps the letters running on in the column if that default comes back
the letter styles set no breakBefore and inherit level 1's disabled break, so B and C open mid-column; a letter that should open a page needs its own breakBefore on its style

Lloyd's classes are set closed up (A1, A2): a no-break space still breaks in paragraphs with bold or italic runs, and 'A 1' split across two lines; the Spanish translation is worded so that numbers stay beside their units
bodyText.maxRuntTracking: 0, because the negative tracking of a runt fix is measured but never painted
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es'); a region-tagged code such as 'es-ES' would hyphenate as American English
every frontmatter value is quoted, so the verso running head's {title} always prints

the same body-size title heading keeps {titleText} on one line: 1.4.1 rebuilds {titleText} from the hidden heading's wrapped lines joined with a space, so a title that wraps after the hyphen of 'Word-Book' prints 'Word- Book' in the band
